name: GAN Inversion Encoder and Optimization
definition: An encoder $E_{θ_E}$ that predicts an initial grid of latent codes $W_0$ given a set of posed views, used for view synthesis via GAN inversion.
summary: GAN Inversion Encoder and Optimization inverts source views into a latent code grid to enable view synthesis and scene completion by optimizing local latent codes rather than sampling from the prior distribution.
